title: Application Architecture Guardrails Catalogue
description: Catalogue of non-negotiable constraints, mandatory standards, and concrete patterns for the Application architecture domain. Aligned to Policy-as-Code conventions (AWS Service Control Policies, Azure Policy).

meta.description: Rules and minimum standards that must be followed in Application Architecture.
purpose: Prevents adoption of application patterns that introduce security or quality risk
Codifies technology standards and approved platforms at the architecture layer
Provides enforceable criteria for application design review
Enables automated guardrail checking during application decision governance
Reduces maintenance burden caused by non-standard technology choices

$schema.description: URN of the schema this instance conforms to (this file's $id).

rule.description: The mandatory constraint or required pattern

scope.description: What the rule applies to (systems, environments, data classifications, etc.)

rationale.description: Why this is mandatory — often references a principle or compliance requirement

enforcement.description: How compliance is checked (automated scan, review gate, manual audit, etc.)

exception-process.description: How an exception can be raised (or 'No exceptions')
